description:
Opt-in knowledge ingest for the tenant knowledge base (AB#8486, Feature AB#8450). A document
in the tenant's Knowledge folder (System.Files root "Knowledge"), or a text or PDF posted to
the HTTP endpoints, becomes a SourceArtifact and then a Draft knowledge page.

Not service-managed: System.Ai.Default (applied on EnableAi to every AI tenant) carries no
ingest pipeline and no LLM call. Only a tenant that installs this blueprint gets them, and
until the per-tenant cost cap AB#8659 exists it is installed only locally and on one opt-in
test-2 tenant with a dedicated API key whose provider-side spend limit is the hard cap.

Seeds:
- the Knowledge folder root (System.Files/FolderRoot "Knowledge")
- AiConfiguration knowledge-llm (calls without tools) and knowledge-llm-mcp (agentic loop and
  page write; carries McpServerUrl) - set the same ApiKey on both after the install and before
  the data flow is deployed
- ServiceAccountConfiguration knowledge-reader (read tools of the generation loop) and
  knowledge-curator (the page write in McpToolCall@1 only); no extra roles, no delegation
- the three KnowledgeCapture prompts (AB#3127) as AiPromptTemplate, PromptPurpose
  KnowledgeGeneration: wiki-prompt-agentic, wiki-prompt-structured, wiki-prompt-verification
  (TemplateVersion 4 = Philipp's v3 with the source as the cacheable main content)
- data flow knowledge-ingest with seven pipelines, all seeded Undeployed:
  knowledge-ingest-file (Knowledge folder watch), knowledge-ingest-text (HTTP text),
  knowledge-ingest-pdf (HTTP PDF), knowledge-source-artifact (bronze, hash dedupe),
  knowledge-generate-agentic (default), knowledge-generate (pipeline variant) and
  knowledge-write-page (the only pipeline that runs as knowledge-curator)

Write path W1: the model only reads (knowledge_search, knowledge_get; no generic entity
reads until AB#8574) and returns schema-valid JSON; the pipeline verifies, normalises the
Markdown and hands the page to knowledge-write-page, which writes through McpToolCall@1 ->
knowledge_upsert_page as knowledge-curator, with run data on the new page version. Pages
start as Draft.

Knowledge lint (1.1.0, AB#8488): data flow knowledge-maintenance with the pipeline knowledge-lint
(service account knowledge-linter, prompt knowledge-lint-contradiction, trigger
knowledge-lint-nightly at 02:30 UTC seeded DISABLED, HTTP POST /knowledge-capture/lint). Rule
checks (orphan, stale, missing link, citation not in source) over all pages; LLM checks
(unsupported claim, contradiction) over at most knowledge-lint-max-pages pages per run (tenant
setting, default 5). The report is written through McpToolCall@1 -> knowledge_write_lint_report
and is always unvalidated until the lint's precision is measured.

Page metadata (1.1.1, AB#8719; found by the first live ingest on test-2 kb-test): every ingest version
carries latencySeconds (start of the generation pipeline to the hand-over of the write; needs
octo-mcp-service with the latencySeconds parameter of knowledge_upsert_page), the page summary is
taken from the generated Summary section (plain text, at most two sentences / 400 characters), and
only confirmed hallucination flags are stored: wiki-prompt-verification TemplateVersion 5 returns
flags with "confirmed", and the pipelines and the lint drop flags the verification withdrew itself.

Set the API key on knowledge-llm and knowledge-llm-mcp BEFORE deploying the data flows, or redeploy
them afterwards: the adapter reads the AiConfiguration when the pipeline is deployed.

Setup, settings and limits: src/SystemAiCkModel/README.md, section "System.Ai.Knowledge".
